compute_similarity_transform: compute a similarity transform (rotation, scale, translation) that aligns 3D points S1 closest to S2 using orthogonal Procrutes
compute_similarity_transform_batch: compute similarity transforms for a batch of 3D point sets by aligning each S1[i] to S2[i]
reconstruction_error: compute the Procrustes-aligned reconstruction error between two batches of 3D point sets with mean or sum reduction
reconstruction_error_fromMesh: compute reconstruction error from mesh vertices by extracting 3D keypoints via a joint regressor and H36M joint mapper
review_pose_utils: review the pose_utils module functions for 3D point alignment and mesh-based reconstruction error computation
